verdict.rationale: Vercel describes itself as a platform for "building, deploying, and scaling" web apps and AI workloads. Fluid compute scales concurrency, production workloads can run in isolated containers, and the same Git-push, preview and production primitives (env management, gradual rollouts) apply across stages. That implies continuity from prototype to production. However, nothing explicitly documents that the same APIs carry an app to massive scale without rearchitecting, and there are no scale case studies or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement or docs on prototype-to-scale continuity without migration, evidence of behaviour at massive scale, independent or hands-on corroboration.
